meta.title: Competitor Radar
meta.niche: Investor management and fund administration software for private equity and real estate general partners

analysis.summary: Rivals are racing to open their data to AI tools and refreshing product pages. Only Agora and InvestNext publish head-to-head comparison pages, and Juniper Square has none.

points.text: Agora has two new comparison pages aimed at Cash Flow Portal and InvestNext users, so it is going after switchers in real estate.
InvestNext and Agora both have MCP pages (a way for AI tools to read your data), and Juniper Square pitches Headless GPX the same way.
SS&C GlobalOps published 10 pages for learners and none for buyers, and one was about Twitter litigation, so it isn't targeting switchers.

Juniper Square.play: Launches AI and data products (Capital Intelligence, JunieAI, Headless GPX) and refreshes 25 product pages.
Juniper Square.aimed: PE, VC and real estate GPs

Allvue Systems.play: One new page, a recap of its NYC event on AI and data. Too small to read as a strategy.

SS&C GlobalOps.play: Publishes opinion and explainers on fund operations, private credit and K-1s. No product pages in this data.

InvestNext.play: Refreshes 16 pages and pushes AI and MCP, with how-tos on AI-assisted investor relations.
InvestNext.aimed: Small and mid-size real estate sponsors

Agora.play: Updates 35 pages, writes real estate how-tos, adds comparison pages and an EisnerAmper accounting partnership.

shared.title: Open data for AI tools
shared.text: Juniper Square's Headless GPX, InvestNext's MCP pages and Agora's API and MCP page all say the platform's data can plug into any AI. Expect this to become table stakes (a basic expectation).

shared.title: Page refresh push
shared.text: Many updated older pages and few new ones: Agora 35, Juniper Square 25, InvestNext 16. All three are polishing product pages, probably to rework their AI and integration messages.

shared.title: Rival comparison pages
shared.text: InvestNext has a page against Agora. Agora has pages on InvestNext and Cash Flow Portal alternatives. They are writing for people already shopping for a switch.

gaps.title: Switching guide for GPs
gaps.text: No one publishes a how-to for moving fund admin or portals, covering data migration, timing and risks. It matches switching buyers' needs directly.

gaps.title: Juniper Square versus rivals
gaps.text: Juniper Square has no comparison pages. Agora and InvestNext already target each other's users, and nobody covers PE and VC fund admin comparisons.

gaps.title: Customer switch stories
gaps.text: Juniper Square has only 2 case studies, and rivals have almost none (SS&C has 1, off-topic). Stories of GPs who switched would be rare proof.

versus.Allvue Systems: Allvue published one event recap, while Juniper Square ships product launches and updates 25 pages. Allvue shows little switcher-focused content here.
versus.SS&C GlobalOps: SS&C writes learning content on operations and risk, while Juniper Square writes mostly product and buying pages. SS&C has no comparison pages.
versus.InvestNext: InvestNext mirrors Juniper Square's AI focus but adds AI how-tos and one comparison page. Juniper Square has no how-to or comparison content.
versus.Agora: Agora has more updates (35 vs 25), plus real estate guides and three comparison pages. Juniper Square covers more asset types but has no comparisons.
